info.title: qEvent Admission Service
info.description: Accounts, ticket orders with the Event Service saga, dynamic QR, and check-in. Protected endpoints verify the JWT inside this service and never trust identity from the body. Errors always use `{ code, message }` except request validation failures, which return the Elysia validation payload. Order creation is idempotent per user and `Idempotency-Key`; an unknown downstream result returns `202` with a `Location` header instead of a false failure.

serviceToken.description: Shared service credential for internal endpoints.

post.summary: Place a ticket order through the Event Service saga
post.description: Requires a unique `Idempotency-Key` per user. Replaying the same key and payload returns the stored result; reusing it with a different payload returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. When the downstream result is unknown (timeout or 5xx), the order stays pending and the response is `202` with `Location` for polling.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Client-generated unique key scoped to the authenticated user.

202.description: Reservation outcome is unknown; the order is pending reconciliation.

409.description: The key conflicts with another payload, or capacity is exhausted.

value.message: Idempotency key reused with a different payload
Ticket type or event capacity is exhausted

post.description: Requires STAFF or ORGANIZER. Verifies the RSA signature and the 30-second TOTP before a compare-and-set update from PAID to CHECKED_IN. Concurrent scans accept exactly one request.

post.description: Requires STAFF or ORGANIZER. Scans are applied in chronological order. The first scan per ticket wins; later scans are reported as CONFLICT. Replayed scans are reported as DUPLICATE and do not change state.
